description: Review settings navigation, regrouped QoL rows and safe submenu return on the exact local artifact.
prerequisites: Disposable save/settings fixture; no active multiplayer session
A visible local display and the input method being tested
Follow tests/manual/settings_menu.md; keep captures and settings evidence local

review.expect: Video settings are readable without overlapping labels, values or footer. Record window/target size and input method.
Video, Audio, Controls, Network, QoL, Mods and System are reachable in both directions. The selected tab scrolls into view at the narrowest tested window.
Fast Loading, Fast-Forward, Lock-On and Free Camera are on QoL. Reversible changes affect the copied settings only; disabled dependent rows cannot change their value.
Back closes the Layered Armor editor to QoL, the Mods browser to Mods and the save/translation browser to System, retaining the parent menu. Cancel without importing personal files.
Close and reopen the menu: selected section, scroll and focus are retained, and gameplay resumes. A separate restart reads the changed copied settings.
Restore QoL Defaults resets its own rows without changing video/audio/network values; environment-locked rows keep their effective values.
A person confirms the actual keyboard/controller/touch controls work, including Back and section selection, without stuck or unintended game inputs.
